title: variant.release, contract version 1
description: Releases a revision of an entry's shared variant (PRD 5.6, 6.4): the entry, the number of the revision to release and the version of the shared variant the caller read. A variant at another version is version_conflict. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Entries\Domain\Commands\ReleaseVariant, and the generated codec ReleaseVariantCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

revision.description: The number of the revision to release.

version.description: The version of the entry's shared variant the caller read.

revision.description: The number of a revision of a variant, an integer of 1 or more.

version.description: The version of an aggregate that the caller read, an integer of 1 or more; the command is version_conflict when the aggregate is at another version when it commits.
